finding.description: The rendered notebook has the setup-pieces section heading as `## 3. Setup pieces`, but the matched taxonomy layout requires the exact heading prefix `## 3. The setup pieces`. The draft carries the same drift, so the notebook generator must correct the section title in its output (and preserve the declared 3.1–3.4 subsections).
finding.proposed_fix: Update the notebook draft/rendered section heading to `## 3. The setup pieces` so it matches the taxonomy `setup_pieces` title; do not rely on the Contents entry alone, and keep the setup-pieces overview plus all declared subsections intact.

rationale: The validator checks actual markdown cell headings, not the table of contents. The taxonomy declares `setup_pieces` with title `## 3. The setup pieces`, while both notebook.ipynb and notebook_draft.py contain `## 3. Setup pieces`; this is a localized producer output mismatch, not an upstream spec or validator defect.
